faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Novato?
faq.answer: Novato homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $13,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This large Marin County city features a mix of 1950s–1980s ranch homes and newer planned communities in areas like Ignacio and Bel Marin Keys. Single window installation starts at approximately $510.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Novato?
faq.answer: Yes. Novato requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Novato Building Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Novato?
faq.answer: For Novato's Marin County suburban market, we most frequently install Milgard Tuscany vinyl for cost-effective replacements, Milgard Ultra fiberglass for homes closer to the Bay with moisture exposure, and Andersen 400-Series for higher-end properties in Bel Marin Keys.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Novato neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Novato communities including Ignacio, Bel Marin Keys, San Marin, Black Point, and downtown Novato. Zip codes: 94945, 94947, 94949.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Novato?
faq.answer: Most Novato projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
